text: 想想现在都四十岁了，还是一事无成，比以前更加焦虑了。
en: Thinking about it now, I am already forty, and still have achieved nothing, more anxious than before.

text: 也更加认命了，现在就是努力的同时，不成功也不会像以前那样暴躁懊恼了。
en: I have also become more resigned to my fate. Now, while I still do my best, if I do not succeed I no longer fly into a temper or brood over it as I used to.

text: 尽力把家里的人安顿好，接接孩子，做做饭，把身体保养好。
en: Do my best to settle the family, pick the children up, cook the meals, and look after my health.

text: “一个人到了四十岁再不信命，说明这个人的悟性太差！
en: “If a person reaches forty and still does not believe in fate, it shows that person's comprehension is too poor!

text: ”这句话现在是我的座右铭。
en: ” This sentence is now my motto.

text: “我命由我不由天”的节奏，一去不复返了。
en: The rhythm of 'my destiny is mine to command, not heaven's' is gone for good.

text: 这些年我养成一个“好”习惯，就是把一切不好的情绪缓解掉，把当下重要的事情拖延下去直到忘却。
en: Over these years I have developed a 'good' habit: easing away every unpleasant emotion, and putting off the important things of the moment until I forget them.

text: 寄托在身边的其他事务给自己一切假象麻醉到自己都信以为真了。
en: Pinning my hopes on other matters around me, I give myself every kind of illusion and anaesthetise myself until I myself believe it is true.

text: 这才是中年危机最大的悲哀，不敢面对！
en: This is the greatest sorrow of the mid-life crisis: the refusal to face up to it!

text: 我有2部手机，就有2个微信，2个微信的零钱总额基本保持在400元上下，滚动着，有一次给车加油，我发2个账号加起来不到200，索性给自己的车加100块，信以为真的觉得，这个油站没有优惠不需要加那么多，等下次去哪个有优惠的站点加油，再加满。
en: I have two mobile phones, so two WeChat accounts. The total balance in the two WeChat wallets stays at roughly 400 yuan, rolling over. Once, when fuelling the car, I found the two accounts added up to less than 200, so I simply put 100 yuan's worth into my own car, genuinely convinced that this petrol station had no discount so there was no need to fill up, and that next time I would go to a station with a promotion and fill the tank then.

text: 其实我也不知道从什么时候起，我的车从没有加满过油了。
en: Actually, I do not know since when, but my car has never been filled to the brim.

text: 偶尔一次被加满了油，还是我老父亲开我的车出去给我加满的，那次我极度尴尬。
en: On the rare occasion it was filled up, it was my old father who drove my car out and filled it for me, and I was utterly mortified that time.

text: 对，钱包的钱永远不够用，这是中年危机的根源。
en: Right, the money in the wallet is never enough — that is the root of the mid-life crisis.
Born in '83, approaching 40.

text: 人生已经走完了一半
en: Half of life has already been walked.

text: 前一半路，有坎坷，有顺途，但最多的还是在不断强化自己的认知
en: The first half of the road had bumps and smooth stretches, but mostly it was about constantly deepening my own understanding.

text: 后一半路，想改变，想颠覆
en: The second half of the road, I want to change, want to subvert.

text: 但迟迟没有跨出去的勇气
en: But the courage to take that step has long been lacking.

text: 40岁，好尴尬的年龄啊！
en: Forty is such an awkward age!

text: 年轻已经不在，说老还差的远，上有老，下有小，想休息一下，结果爸妈已老，孩子还小…
en: Youth is already gone, yet calling it old is far off; there are elders above and children below. I want to rest a while, but my parents are already old and the children are still young…

text: 收入赶不上消费，房贷，车贷，孩子教育，老人赡养，都要花钱，自己的消费水平一直在压缩，越来越低
en: Income cannot keep up with spending — the mortgage, the car loan, the children's education, the care of the elderly, all cost money, and my own standard of consumption keeps being compressed, ever lower.

text: 孩子的教育，家庭的一地鸡毛，两口子的争吵，这些都是常态呀。
en: The children's education, the household mess, the squabbles between husband and wife — these are all the norm.

text: 但痛并快乐着，生活虐我千百遍，我待她如初恋
en: But it hurts and yet is joyful; life has trampled me a thousand times, yet I treat her like a first love.

text: 40岁，就是一个比较“绕嘴”的年龄，不相信青春已去也不情愿青春已去，不相信中年已来更不情愿进入中年。
en: Forty is a rather 'awkward to say' age — refusing to believe youth has gone yet unwilling for youth to have gone; refusing to believe middle age has arrived, still less willing to enter middle age.

text: 40岁左右，是一个承上启下的阶段，身上或许还带着些许没有耗尽的少年英气，但同时，身上也有了无论如何也抹不掉的岁月痕迹。
en: Around forty is a stage that bridges what came before and what follows. One may still carry a little of the unspent heroism of youth, yet at the same time bear the marks of the years that can never be erased, no matter what.

text: 40岁，你将第一次听到身体对你说“不”。
en: At forty, you will hear your body say 'no' to you for the first time.

text: 40岁，同时也让你看到了更远一些的未来…
en: At forty, you are also shown a future a little further off…

text: 以上，算是40岁的一点人生体会吧。
en: The above, I suppose, is a little of the life experience of being forty.

text: 打工人，兢兢业业打工，带娃，尽量让生活井井有条，希望孩子健康长大，不要有太多节外生枝，就很满足了。
en: A working person, labouring diligently, raising the children, trying to keep life in good order, hoping the children grow up healthy without too many complications — and that is contentment enough.

text: 没有别的奢望，深知我们把握不了那么多，走一步是一步。
en: No other extravagant hopes; I know full well we cannot control so much — we take it one step at a time.

text: 有车有房，没资产没存款没房租。
en: We have a car and a house, but no assets, no savings, no rent to collect.

text: 年近40心态才越来越接地气，越来越懂的生活，越来越深知，一切没有定数，没有消息就是好消息，有福同享有难同当，有福不指望，有难必须抱团。
en: Only nearing forty has my mindset become more down-to-earth, more understanding of life, and ever more aware that nothing is fixed — no news is good news; we share fortune and face hardship together; we do not count on fortune, but must band together in hardship.

text: 祝福全家人，平安顺遂健康快乐，永远的心愿。
en: I bless the whole family with peace, smoothness, health and happiness — my eternal wish.

text: 没有钱，生活质量却很不错，不亏待自己的感受，享受现在的平淡快乐。
en: No money, yet the quality of life is quite good; I do not wrong my own feelings, and enjoy the plain happiness of now.

text: 今年周岁38了，现在体会很深。
en: This year I have turned 38 by actual age, and the feeling runs deep now.

text: 事业已经停滞不全，不知如何是好；家庭二胎，双方父母健康，也算美满。
en: My career has stalled and is incomplete, and I do not know what to do; with a second child in the family and both sets of parents in good health, it is, all things considered, a happy arrangement.

text: 今晚，跟老婆吵了一架，根本原因就是老婆总是惦记着再买套更大的阳光房。
en: Tonight, I had a row with my wife; the root cause is that she is always hankering to buy another, bigger sunroom.

text: 我就想不明白了，名下有两套房了，而且都是学区房，而且存款又没那么多钱，哪来的底气和实力，到底在想什么？
en: I simply cannot make sense of it. We already have two properties in our name, both school-district homes, and we do not have that much in savings — where does she get the confidence and the means, what on earth is she thinking?

text: 不敢死，活不下去
en: Dare not die, cannot go on living.

text: 不同阶层的人感受不一样
en: People of different classes feel it differently.

text: 首先 请问下需要什么样的人生体会 我可以给您规划不同的人生
en: First, may I ask what sort of life experience you need? I can plan different lives for you.

text: 一地鸡毛！
en: A household mess!

text: 勇猛精进！
en: Courageous advancement!

text: 未来可期！
en: The future holds promise!

text: 特别充实呗
en: Especially fulfilling, really.

text: 老得比我们老，年轻的比我们年轻，想奋力一博却害怕失去拥有的，而此刻拥有的却又不是自己想要的.
en: Those older than us are older; those younger than us are younger. I want to strive for one great push yet fear losing what I have, yet what I have at this moment is not what I want.

text: 今天还在加班的夜晚
en: Tonight, still working overtime.

text: 我与合伙人正在给客户出方案
en: My partner and I are putting together a proposal for a client.

text: 今天的天气忽热忽冷忽而来一阵风
en: Today's weather turns hot then cold, then a gust of wind comes suddenly.

text: 马上40岁了
en: Turning forty soon.

text: 也不记得有多少个加班的夜晚
en: And I cannot remember how many nights of overtime there have been.

text: 以前在大公司
en: Before, at a big company.

text: 现在自己创业的小公司
en: Now, a small company of my own founding.

text: 感觉很多人都有很丰富多彩的青年, 中年生活
en: It feels like many people have rich and colourful youth and middle-aged lives.

text: 回首过往, 真的加班很多
en: Looking back, there really was a lot of overtime.

text: 今天, 我听了一些近期的消息
en: Today, I heard some recent news.

text: 有朋友的近况, 有周围的消息
en: There was news of friends, and news from around me.

text: 深感作为一名中年人
en: Deeply feeling, as a middle-aged person,

text: 我们一定要提高自身的能量
en: we must raise our own energy.

text: 保持健康, 身心健康
en: Keep healthy — physically and mentally well.

text: 保持向上, 即便只是积硅步
en: Keep moving upward, even if only by accumulating tiny steps.

text: 我现在根本不想那些曾经反复出现在心中的远大目标
en: Now I simply do not think about those grand ambitions that once recurred in my heart.

text: 而是选择每天踏踏实实的见好客户, 做好方案, 一点一点向前
en: Instead I choose, each day, to meet good clients steadily, do the proposals well, and move forward little by little.

text: 好好吃饭
en: Eat well.

text: 吃一顿温馨的早餐, 充满能量的午餐, 以及快乐的晚餐
en: Eat a warm breakfast, an energising lunch, and a happy dinner.

text: 好好睡觉
en: Sleep well.

text: 人到中年能睡个好觉那就是幸福
en: To sleep soundly once you reach middle age — that is happiness.

text: 最近做了很多梦
en: Lately I have had many dreams.

text: 我祝愿, 并希望, 天下善良的人, 美梦成真
en: I wish, and hope, that all the kind people under heaven see their beautiful dreams come true.

text: 永葆善良的心, 感恩的心, 积极向上的心❤️
en: Forever keep a kind heart, a grateful heart, an upward-striving heart ❤️

text: 一名中年人在加班中途的心路历程
en: The inner journey of a middle-aged person amid overtime.

text: 在这个社会上，普通人只有在35-40岁左右，才能基本明白社会运行的真相和底层逻辑，而这个时候，他们已经被社会毒打得没了脾气。
en: In this society, ordinary people only come to understand the truth and underlying logic of how society works at around 35 to 40, and by then they have been beaten down by society until they have no fight left.

text: 富人阶层的小孩，在20岁已经变得通透，深刻洞悉人性与社会的潜规则，做什么都是得心应手，因为他们的才能与智慧是家族的传承，几代人努力的结果。
en: The children of the wealthy class become clear-sighted at twenty, deeply grasping the unspoken rules of human nature and society, and handle everything with ease, because their talent and wisdom are a family inheritance, the fruit of several generations' effort.

text: 大部分穷二代只有到35岁左右的时候，才能深刻领悟到金钱与权势的重要性，因为学校没有告诉他们社会的残酷，父母也没有告诉他们赚钱的逻辑。
en: Most second-generation poor only come to a deep realisation of the importance of money and power at around thirty-five, because school never told them of society's cruelty, nor did their parents teach them the logic of making money.

text: 他们在35岁以前，基本上还是学生思维，只知道埋头苦干，不懂人情世故；总是试图追求公平，而别人暗地里却在送礼，拉关系；总是被动等待老板加工资，他们不知道好东西是需要自己争取的。
en: Before thirty-five, they are essentially still in a student mindset — only knowing how to plug away, ignorant of the ways of the world; always trying to pursue fairness, while others quietly give gifts and curry favour; always passively waiting for the boss to raise their pay, not knowing that good things must be fought for.

text: 穷人的孩子都是一群温顺的羊羔，他们没有狼的侵略性，资本家撒的那把饲料，只能让他们满足温饱，不可能让他们买车买房，实现自我价值。
en: The children of the poor are a flock of docile lambs; they lack the wolf's aggression. The feed the capitalists scatter can only keep them fed and clothed — it can never let them buy a car or a home and realise their self-worth.

text: 当他们真正觉醒的那一刻，青春已经流逝，想弯道超车，已经来不及。
en: By the moment they truly awaken, youth has already slipped away; it is too late to attempt a corner overtake.

text: 更可怕的是，父母已经老去，孩子需要上各种各样的培训班。
en: What is more frightening is that the parents have grown old, and the children need all sorts of tuition classes.

text: 此时，他们才知道金钱有多么重要。
en: Only then do they learn how important money is.

text: 所谓的勤劳致富，吃得苦中苦，方为人上人，都是世界上最大的谎言。
en: So-called getting rich through hard work, enduring the bitterest of hardship to rise above others — these are the greatest lies in the world.

text: 所以穷二次唯一的出路就是认知觉醒，越早觉醒，人生逆袭的可能性就越大，时间不会等人，生命只有一次，因为80岁的悔恨，已经没有任何意义。
en: Therefore the only way out for the second-generation poor is an awakening of understanding. The earlier the awakening, the greater the chance of a life turnaround. Time waits for no one, and life has but one chance, for regret at eighty is already meaningless.

text: 职场如战场，这个没有硝烟的战场里，处处充满着算计，处处充满着流言，处处充满着欺骗，要想在其中生存发展，就必须要研究人性、悟透人性、利用人性，才能在这个社会有一席之地。
en: The workplace is like a battlefield; in this smokeless battlefield, calculation is everywhere, gossip is everywhere, deception is everywhere. To survive and thrive within it, one must study human nature, see through human nature, and make use of human nature, so as to earn a place in this society.

text: 在这里，我推荐大家看看金锋写的《职场避坑指南》（淘宝、京东有售），这本书能解决职场中的很多问题，内容有大谋略，也有小技巧，教你在轻松解决同事推卸工作、同事甩锅、同事打小报告、同事邀功等等棘手问题，让你在职场中会说话、会办事、会做人，用最小的付出换取最大的回报，你一定要看看！
en: Here, I recommend everyone read 'A Guide to Avoiding Pitfalls in the Workplace' by Feng Jin (available on Taobao and JD). This book can solve many problems in the workplace; its content ranges from grand strategy to small tricks, teaching you to handle with ease thorny issues like colleagues shirking work, colleagues shifting blame, colleagues snitching, and colleagues claiming credit, so that you learn to speak well, act well, and conduct yourself well in the workplace, gaining the greatest return for the least effort. You really ought to take a look!
